quote: Introducing GPT-5.6 series: Sol, Terra and Luna. Coming July 9 10am PT
kind_note: shipped model: flagship of the GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna), a separately priced API model
note: Lab (OpenAI) and kind (shipped) confirmed. Preview: MacRumors (https://macrumors.com/2026/06/26/openai-gpt-5-6-sol/) says the limited preview launched "Friday June 26, 2026 11:16 am PDT"; OpenAI's developer forum post also says "Today OpenAI is previewing GPT-5.6 Sol" on June 26. The preview was limited to trusted partners during a U.S. government safety review. The quote is the headline of OpenAI's forum announcement; its body does not restate the date. The July 9 general-availability date is corroborated by The Decoder (https://the-decoder.com/openais-gpt-5-6-launches-thursday-after-a-delay-forced-by-the-u-s-government/, dated July 8, 2026: "OpenAI's GPT-5.6 models ship Thursday"; July 9, 2026 is a Thursday) and DataNorth (https://datanorth.ai/news/openai-releases-gpt-5-6-sol-terra-and-luna, published July 9, 2026: "OpenAI has made its GPT-5.6 model family generally available"). Not settled: OpenAI's launch page (openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/) and help-center article returned HTTP 403 to my fetches, so OpenAI's own GA sentence is unverified; sources do not clearly say whether July 9 gave full access across ChatGPT, Codex and the API or was staged. Terra and Luna share the same date per sources.
